description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Lists the dates of a recurrence exactly: daily / weekly (on chosen weekdays) / monthly (on day numbers like 1, 15 or -1 for the last day, or the nth weekday like 2nd Tuesday or -1 for the last Friday) / yearly, every N periods, from a start date up to a count or an until date. Days that do not exist (31 February) are skipped or clamped as you choose. Optional business-day adjustment (following, preceding, modified following) with your weekend rule and holidays, each moved date marked. Up to 500 dates.

adjust.description: move dates off weekends/holidays; modified_following stays in the same month

count.description: how many dates (default 12 when no until)

missingDay.description: when a month lacks the day (31st, Feb 29): skip (default) or use the last day

monthDays.description: monthly: day numbers, -1 = last day of the month

nth.description: monthly: 1 = first, 2 = second, -1 = last of the weekday in weekdays

weekdays.description: weekly: which days; monthly with nth: the weekday

name: date_series
title: Recurring dates: every 2nd Tuesday, last business day of the month, every 2 weeks
